en.text:
Throwing Knife Kills grant 2.5-5% Super Energy depending on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />.



Passively increases Blade Barrage impact and explosive damage by 25%.

Landing 5 <solar/>Blade Barrage knives triggers a <solar/>Solar Detonation, up to a maximum of 2 Solar Detonations per cast.

Each <solar/>Solar Detonation deals significant damage across a 10 meter radius with no falloff and releases 4 <solar/>Scorching Shrapnel, which apply <solar/>20 Scorch each (unaffected? by <solar/>Ember of Ashes). Detonation and shrapnel deal ~35% reduced damage to Boss-Tier combatants and are not buffed by the Super Stat.

<solar/>Blade Barrage Hits and Kills refund Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank, up to a maximum of 50%.

Overall increase to Blade Barrage damage (against Boss Combatants) is roughly ~140%.
